page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core workloads. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10 percent. Conversely, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores, which all sit in the middle 50 percent tier. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the average range, with read-only large block uncached speeds at 98.48 GB/sec and write speeds at 49.01 GB/sec.

Given its hardware profile and performance characteristics, this instance is suited for multi-threaded applications that can leverage its 32 dedicated cores, such as static web serving, software compilation, and database operations, which both achieved average tier benchmark results. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks or workloads requiring high-speed local storage. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density for legacy enterprise workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the premium cost of newer-generation architectures.
